description: This file contains SwiftUI views and related classes for the Voice Wake Overlay Text Views component in a macOS app, including a customizable transcript text view with editing features and a vibrant label view.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: Coordinator class for managing NSTextView delegate callbacks within TranscriptTextView.

classes.name: ClickCatcher
classes.description: Custom NSView subclass detecting mouse clicks to handle tap gestures in VibrantLabelView.

classes.name: TranscriptNSTextView
classes.description: Customized NSTextView subclass with handlers for send, begin editing, end editing, and escape key events.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates a Coordinator instance for managing text view delegate callbacks.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSScrollView containing the text view.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSScrollView and inner text view with new attributed text when needed.
